_comment: B3 ui.json — exhaustive: every SCHEMA-VALID ui key is present so the 'reference fixture resolves end-to-end' tests exercise the whole family at once. The 2 code-only keys (ui.interactiveShapes / ui.scaleType) are DELIBERATELY ABSENT — ui.schema.json has additionalProperties:false, so including them would fail validate-profiles. They are read by live code but unreachable via the contract (ANO-036/037, locked in s11-ui-anomalies-lock.test.js). Several values are picked distinct from code defaults (theme:dark, permalink.mode:query, positions:topright) so per-value tests can distinguish a real read from a default fallback. The table panel config moved to modules.table (config/plugins/table.json) — extraction roadmap table S4. The filter/search panel config moved to modules.filter (config/plugins/filter.json) — capacité in-core filter S5. The legend config (showLegend + legendConfig) moved to modules.legend (config/plugins/legend.json) — capacité in-core legend S10/F2. The share button flag (showShareButton) moved to modules.permalink.share — sub-feature of the in-core permalink capability (share S12 → permalink S13/F7).
